caption: A desk fan with a bent blade is switched on, and the whole fan wobbles visibly on its base as the blades spin.

sa.check: A desk fan stands on a surface.
The fan is switched on: the blades start to spin.
The whole fan wobbles on its base.
One blade is bent, visible while the fan is still.
The switch-on comes first and the wobble follows.

pc.expect: The fan is still before the switch and wobbles only while the blades spin.
pc.fail: The fan wobbles before the blades turn; or wobbles while the blades are plainly stopped; or slides across the desk in a smooth glide.

pc.expect: While the blades spin the fan wobbles in a steady rhythm, and the wobble ends when the blades stop.
pc.fail: The blades spin fast and the fan stands dead still for the whole clip; or the blades stop and the wobble goes on unchanged; or the wobble comes in irregular fits with long still spells while the blades spin steadily.

pc.expect: The fan stays on its base; if it walks to the edge it falls.
pc.fail: The fan lifts off the desk; or tips and hangs at an angle unsupported; or rises.

pc.expect: The cage and base are rigid; the blades are rigid and the bent one stays bent.
pc.fail: The cage flexes like cloth; or the base bends; or the bent blade straightens itself while spinning.

pc.expect: One fan; the blades keep their count and stay inside the cage.
pc.fail: A second fan appears; or the fan vanishes; or a blade passes through the cage; or the blades change count.

pc.expect: Everything in view, named in the caption or not, keeps its number, identity and shape unless something visible acts on it, and nothing passes through anything else.
pc.fail: An object that nothing visible acts on appears from nothing; or vanishes while still in frame and not occluded; or duplicates or merges with another; or turns into a different object or a different shape between frames; or any object passes through another. Changes brought about by the caption's event or by a visible interaction, objects leaving the frame, and occlusion are not failures.

pc.expect: The fan's colour, its cage pattern and the wall behind stay the same.
pc.fail: The fan changes colour; or the cage changes pattern; or the wall behind changes.
